breaking: BookingCalendar is a server component; without onBook/onDateChange it ships no JS and the Book button is a native submit
onBook and onDateChange load the client island booking-calendar.client.tsx (817 B gzip) and work only when the calendar is rendered from a client component or receives a server action
days and times are native radio inputs; new props name (default "date") and timeName (default "time") send the choice with a form
all months between minDate (or the first free day) and maxDate (or the last free day) are rendered at once, max 24, and switched by hidden radios
keyboard: native radio groups (Tab per group, arrows between free days and times); Home/End/PageUp/PageDown and week jumps removed
the grid is no longer role=grid/table; days without free times are plain text
new file booking-calendar.client.tsx must be added to registry.json

how.en: Server grid, radio inputs and :checked; JS island only for onBook
how.ru: Сетка на сервере, радиокнопки и :checked; JS только для onBook
